objects.description: [Mini Shai-Hulud](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9043) has wiped data on devices that fall within specified parameters to include those that resolve to specific geolocations including Iran and Israel.(Citation: Hunt.io TeamPCP Toolkit MAY 2026)(Citation: Phoenix TeamPCP 20 MAY 2026) [Mini Shai-Hulud](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9043) has also implemented a dead-man’s switch that wipes the victims home directory if the operator revokes a GitHub token created by the adversary. (Citation: Flashpoint Mini Shai-Hulud MAY 2026)
